Author: @pedrostormrage
Content:
" 'Splitting the G' refers to timing your initial taste of Guinness so that the surface of the beer lines up perfectly with a specific part of the letter G in the Guinness logo.  Some say it’s all about hitting the horizontal bar of the G, others argue it’s where the harp meets the letter, and still others claim it’s the perfect juncture between the top of the letter and the bottom of the harp".
Edit: the joke is that when "splitting the G" you're only supposed to drink enough beer to make its surface reach that part of the letter G on the glass, but he just drank the whole thing instead (subverting the expectation of "splitting the G", while still "proving his Irishness" in a different way). Also, the source of that quote is an InDublin article called "Everything you need to know about 'Split the G'".

Author: @TheNilla2020
Content: Split the G" is a drinking challenge associated with Guinness beer. It refers to the act of taking a large first gulp of Guinness so that the foam line of the beer perfectly splits the "G" in the Guinness logo on the glass. Essentially, the goal is to make the line between the dark beer and the creamy head fall directly in the middle of the "G".
